technical_reasoning.rationale: Distinguishes candidate generation, evidence vectors, scoring, pair policy and reversible lifecycle, but the central resolution mechanism remains underspecified: independent pair thresholds plus a vague contradiction override do not define consistent person membership for the three-record bridge. No conservative group abstention rule, reliable cannot-link policy or cluster repair is supplied. Calibration is also asserted as a scorer output rather than justified by candidate-population validation, and the bundled experiment obscures independent module effects. These are important missing assumptions and mechanisms, not minor omissions. There is no explicit endorsement of unconditional connected components or the three-record union, so the scenario critical-failure cap is not triggered.
